To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a method to convert a lengthy patent claim to a conceptual graph.

(1) a finite state machine is proposed to split a lengthy patent claim into a set of sub-sentences; (2) a conceptual graph is constructed based on a domain ontology and a dependency tree of a split patent claim; (3) the precision and recall of the concept and relation classes in a conceptual graph are 96% & 89%, and 97% & 98%, respectively; and (4) the precision for concept linking of a relationship is 79%.
we have successfully applied the NLP techniques to convert a patent into a formally defined CG.
